title: Three specialty orders waiting for a cationic campaign
what_happened: 2.1 t of cationic orders are booked against the 4 t the plant needs before it runs the polymer. The oldest has waited 19 days. Two of the three are the company's premium accounts.

options.option: Run the campaign now with 2.1 t
options.cost: About Rs 47,000 of changeover for 2.1 t
Predicted 21 more days; two premium accounts late

options.option: Sell 1.9 t more cationic yarn this week
options.cost: Needs a buyer; none named yet

ask: Which of the three, decided by the two V4s together.

title: L03 and L12 idle for want of orders while texturising is 17-24 days deep
what_happened: Two extrusion lines lost about a fifth of their capacity to no orders in 30 days. Texturising and twisting are booked three weeks ahead. The plant is short downstream and idle upstream at the same time.
ask: Is this a selling problem or a mix problem? It decides who acts.

title: Priority on Velan's 12 t order pushed six other orders by about four days
what_happened: The MD marked a 12 t commodity order urgent on 30 Sep. It jumped six lots on L06 and L08. Their predicted dates moved by four days each; four of them now land after their promised date, and one has no promised date at all.
ask: Show the MD the cost of the override at the moment he sets it, not afterwards.

title: The delivery model is not ready to quote to customers
what_happened: Average miss 6.8 days. The range is claimed to hold 70% of the time and holds 61%. 30% of misses come from planner decisions that are written down nowhere.
ask: Marketing wants dates to promise. The plant wants a reason column in the plan. Neither has happened.

title: Dhow Gate Trading: Rs 12.6 Cr to Rs 1.9 Cr in two years, reason unknown
what_happened: The largest export account is close to gone. Three mails since June have no reply. Nobody has visited.

options.cost: About Rs 1.5 lakh and a week
Rs 1.9 Cr of remaining revenue at risk

ask: Decide whether it is worth a visit.

title: Hearthline Living asks for a 500 kg trial lot in three weeks
what_happened: A UK retailer with 340 stores wants a trial. A 500 kg lot earns about Rs 26,000 and costs at least Rs 47,000 to set up. It loses money on the day.

options.option: Run it as an investment with a stated test question and a kill rule
options.cost: About Rs 21,000 net, 12 hours of a line

ask: Approve or refuse the trial, and say on what condition.

title: The '+29% premium' on Nilgiri Drapes rests on 21% of its kilos
what_happened: The sales review quotes Nilgiri as the highest-paying account. Only a fifth of what it buys has any peer to compare against. The two premiums that hold up are Ambara (+13% on 78%) and Strapline (+11% on 71%).
ask: Stop quoting Nilgiri as proof that customers pay for specialty.

title: The plant takes 9.5 days on median to answer a customer brief
what_happened: Two pursuits were lost while a sample or a reply was late (Bhoomi Rugs, Indravati). The marketing team has no promised reply time to give a customer.
ask: Agree a reply time and who in the plant answers a brief.

title: Reweight the prospect score?
what_happened: The current score does barely better than guessing on quantity. A reweight lifts top-quarter precision from 60% to 73% on a blind test.

options.cost: Prospect order changes; Lumio Blinds and Pragati Filtration drop below the gate of 70

title: Karnavati offers 18 t of commodity at Rs 352/kg to fill L12 in October
what_happened: L12 is idle. Peers pay about Rs 380 for the same construction. At Rs 352 the order covers variable cost and contributes about Rs 28/kg on Finance's estimate, which has no product-level cost behind it.

options.cost: Sets a price the other four traders will hear about

options.option: Refuse and keep L12 open for specialty
options.cost: About 18 t of idle capacity if nothing else comes

ask: Accept or refuse. This is the order kind the mandate's direction D-01 is about.

title: Kongu Weaves Exports' EU buyer wants GRS-certified recycled yarn
what_happened: Anantha does not hold GRS. Vasanta does. The three Kongu accounts are one company and together are Anantha's sixth-largest customer.
ask: Decide whether to start GRS certification (about 5 months).

title: Three mixed-lustre orders due on L04
what_happened: Mixed-lustre orders cannot share a changeover. Run in any order, each writes off cleaning loss.
ask: Run, or ask marketing to price MX orders for the loss they carry.
